changelog:
v4.2.2 — TV Guide upgrade + clearer unavailable-title message

• TV Guide overhaul: live channel preview while you browse, a Now Playing / Up Next header for the selected channel, and a new toolbar — Global Search, Full Screen, an adjustable hours window, and Jump to Now. Hold OK on a channel to favorite it (inline ★), and page through the timeline faster.
• When a movie or series is listed but your provider isn't actually serving it, the app now says "This title isn't available from your provider right now" and fails fast — instead of a generic playback error or a long retry.

Applies to all devices.
